50307-fifteen-sonnets-of-petrarch.title: Fifteen Sonnets Of Petrarch
50307-fifteen-sonnets-of-petrarch.creator: Unknown
50307-fifteen-sonnets-of-petrarch.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Quando Amor i begli occhi a terra inchina  E i vaghi spirti in un sospiro accoglie  Con le sue mani, e poi in voce gli scioglie  Chiara, soave, angelica, divina;  Sento far del mio cor dolce rapina,  E sì dentro cangiar pensieri e voglie,  Ch'i' dico: or fien di me l'ultime spoglie,  Se 'l Ciel sì onesta morte mi destina.

arxiv-1503-04988.title: Perfect Consistent Hashing
arxiv-1503-04988.creator: Matthew Sackman
arxiv-1503-04988.description: Abstract Consistent Hashing functions are widely used for load balancing across a variety of applications. However, the original presentation and typical implementations of Consistent Hashing rely on randomised allocation of hash codes to keys which results in a flawed and approximately-uniform allocation of keys to hash codes.

arxiv-1906-03733.title: The stability manifold of local orbifold elliptic quotients Thanks: The author was partially supported by NSF-FRG grant DMS 1663813 and by EPSRC grant EP/R034826/1
arxiv-1906-03733.creator: Franco Rota
arxiv-1906-03733.description: Abstract . We study the stability manifold of local models of orbifold quotients of elliptic curves. In particular, we show that a region of the stability manifold is a covering space of the regular set of the Tits cone of the associated elliptic root system.

arxiv-2203-15799.title: StyleT2I: Toward Compositional and High-Fidelity Text-to-Image Synthesis
arxiv-2203-15799.creator: Zhiheng Li, Martin Renqiang Min, Kai Li, Chenliang Xu
arxiv-2203-15799.description: Abstract Although progress has been made for text-to-image synthesis, previous methods fall short of generalizing to unseen or underrepresented attribute compositions in the input text. Lacking compositionality could have severe implications for robustness and fairness, e.g., inability to synthesize the face images of underrepresented demographic groups.

arxiv-2206-15105.title: Approximation Algorithms for Continuous Clustering and Facility Location Problems
arxiv-2206-15105.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider center-based clustering problems where C C , the set of points to be clustered, lies in a metric space ( X , d ) (X,d) , and the set X X of candidate centers is potentially infinite-sized.

arxiv-2405-06203.title: A First Step in Using Machine Learning Methods to Enhance Interaction Analysis for Embodied Learning Environments
arxiv-2405-06203.creator: Joyce Fonteles, Eduardo Davalos, Ashwin T. S, Yike Zhang, Mengxi Zhou, Efrat Ayalon, Alicia Lane, Selena Steinberg, Gabriella Anton, Joshua Danish, Noel Enyedy, Gautam Biswas
arxiv-2405-06203.description: Abstract Investigating children’s embodied learning in mixed-reality environments, where they collaboratively simulate scientific processes, requires analyzing complex multimodal data to interpret their learning and coordination behaviors. Learning scientists have developed Interaction Analysis (IA) methodologies for analyzing such data, but this requires researchers to watch hours of videos to extract and interpret students’ learning patterns.

arxiv-2406-14139.title: Comparing the Effects of Visual, Haptic, and Visuohaptic Encoding on Memory Retention of Digital Objects in Virtual Reality
arxiv-2406-14139.creator: Lucas Siqueira Rodrigues, Timo Torsten Schmidt, Johann Habakuk Israel, Stefan Zachow, John Nyakatura, Thomas Kosch
arxiv-2406-14139.description: Abstract . Although Virtual Reality (VR) has undoubtedly improved human interaction with 3D data, users still face difficulties retaining important details of complex digital objects in preparation for physical tasks. To address this issue, we evaluated the potential of visuohaptic integration to improve the memorability of virtual objects in immersive visualizations.

arxiv-2504-17050.title: Mapping Trafficking Networks: A Data-Driven Approach to Disrupt Human Trafficking Post Russia-Ukraine Conflict
arxiv-2504-17050.creator: Murat Ozer, Goksel Kucukkaya, Yasin Kose, Assel Mukasheva, Kazim Ciris, Bharath V. Penumatcha
arxiv-2504-17050.description: Abstract This study proposes a prototype for locating important individuals and financial exchanges in networks of people trafficking that have grown during the conflict between Russia and Ukraine. It focuses on the role of digital platforms, cryptocurrencies, and the dark web in facilitating these operations.

arxiv-2505-14641.title: VC-dimension of subsets of Hamming graphs
arxiv-2505-14641.creator: Christopher Housholder, Layna Mangiapanello, Steven Senger
arxiv-2505-14641.description: Abstract Following recent work on the VC-dimension of subsets of various pseudorandom graphs, we study the VC-dimension of Hamming graphs, which have proved somewhat resistant to the standard techniques in the literature. Our methods are elementary, and agree with or improve upon previously known results.

kipling-kim-1901.title: Kim
kipling-kim-1901.creator: Rudyard Kipling
kipling-kim-1901.description: An Irish orphan roams India with a Tibetan lama amid the Great Game's espionage — Kipling's beloved masterpiece.

pmc-10627465.title: The functional role of visual information and fixation stillness in the quiet eye
pmc-10627465.creator: David J. Harris, Mark R. Wilson, Samuel J. Vine, Nick Fogt, Nick Fogt, Nick Fogt, Nick Fogt, Nick Fogt
pmc-10627465.description: The final fixation to a target in far-aiming tasks, known as the quiet eye, has been consistently identified as an important perceptual-cognitive variable for task execution. Yet, despite a number of proposed mechanisms it remains unclear whether the fixation itself is driving performance effects or is simply an emergent property of underpinning cognitions.

pmc-11467303.title: Impact of background input on memory consolidation
pmc-11467303.creator: Martina Lamberti, Nikolaos Kikirikis, Michel J. A. M. van Putten, Joost le Feber
pmc-11467303.description: Memory consolidation involves repeated replay of new information by the hippocampus, which transfers memories to the neocortex for long-term storage. This occurs mainly during slow wave sleep, a phase characterized in the cortex by low cholinergic tone and low afferent input.

pmc-11500167.title: Automated classification in turtles genus Malayemys using ensemble multiview image based on improved YOLOv8 with CNN
pmc-11500167.creator: Wararat Songpan, Thotsapol Chaianunporn, Khemika Lomthaisong, Sarun Keithmaleesatti
pmc-11500167.description: In Thailand, two snail-eating turtle species in the genus Malayemes (M. subtrijuga and M. macrocephala) are protected animals in which smuggling and trading are illegal. Recently, a new species M. khoratensis has been reported and it has not yet been considered as protected animal species. To enforce the law, species identification of Malayemes is crucial.

pmc-11538274.title: Towards industry-ready additive manufacturing: AI-enabled closed-loop control for 3D melt electrowriting
pmc-11538274.creator: Pawel Mieszczanek, Peter Corke, Courosh Mehanian, Paul D Dalton, Dietmar W Hutmacher
pmc-11538274.description: Melt electrowriting (MEW) is an emerging high-resolution 3D printing technology used in biomedical engineering, regenerative medicine, and soft robotics. Its transition from academia to industry faces challenges such as slow experimentation, low printing throughput, poor reproducibility, and user-dependent operation, largely due to the nonlinear and multiparametric nature of the MEW process.

pmc-11548181.title: Massive Point Cloud Processing for Efficient Construction Quality Inspection and Control
pmc-11548181.creator: Zhansheng Liu, Zehong Liu, Zhe Sun
pmc-11548181.description: The construction of large-scale civil infrastructures requires massive spatiotemporal data to support the management and control of scheduling, quality control, and safety monitoring. Existing artificial-intelligence-based data processing algorithms rely heavily on experienced engineers to adjust the parameters of data processing, which is inefficient and time-consuming when dealing with huge datasets.

pmc-11713415.title: Using community health workers to assess the prevalence of dementia in a community based sample of older Zambians
pmc-11713415.creator: Mataa M Mataa, Lisa Kalungwana, Chiti Bwalya, Faith Simushi, Lottie Hachaambwa, Linah Mwango, Coolwe Namangala, Leroy Yankae, David Daniel, Jeremy A Tanner, Melissa A Elafros
pmc-11713415.description: BackgroundIn Zambia, dementia prevalence is unknown due to limited community awareness and a lack of providers skilled in recognizing and diagnosing this disease. Community healthcare workers (CHWs) are widely utilized across sub‐Saharan Africa to improve health care access, particularly HIV services. CHWs may be an untapped resource to raise awareness, screen for dementia, and support dementia care in the community.

pmc-13056723.title: Präventionsfelder der Endokrinologie/Diabetologie – „The Big Five“
pmc-13056723.creator: Martin Pfohl, Martin Reincke, Jochen Seufert, Jochen Feldkamp, Martin Fassnacht, Martin Merkel, Jan Tuckermann
pmc-13056723.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Die Präventionsfelder in der Endokrinologie umfassen fünf wichtige Bereiche („The Big Five“): Schilddrüsenerkrankungen, Adipositas und Diabetes mellitus, Fettstoffwechselstörungen, arterielle Hypertonie und Osteoporose. Diese Krankheitsbilder sind häufige „Volkskrankheiten“ und weisen eine hohe Folgemorbidität und -mortalität auf. Sie lassen sich zum Teil durch relativ einfache nichtpharmakologische Maßnahmen vermeiden oder durch niederschwellige pharmakologische Interventionen in ihren Auswirkungen deutlich verringern, sodass sie generell Modellkrankheiten für die Prävention und Vorsorge darstellen. Diesbezügliche Optionen werden in unserem Beitrag aufgezeigt und im Kontext der derzeitigen Präventionsstrategien diskutiert.

pmc-13158278.title: Intestinal Ultrasound Adds Diagnostic Value and Safety to a Dietitian‐Led Clinic for Disorders of Gut–Brain Interaction
pmc-13158278.creator: R. M. Mathias, S. L. Plush, L. E. Edwards, D. Bogatic, L. Bibb, T. M. Goodsall, A. S. Day, R. V. Bryant
pmc-13158278.description: BackgroundDisorders of gut–brain interaction (DGBI) affect approximately 40% of the global population. Multidisciplinary models incorporating dietetic management are increasingly used, yet objective assessment tools remain limited. This study evaluated the clinical utility of intestinal ultrasound (IUS) within a dietitian‐led DGBI clinic.MethodsConsecutive patients underwent IUS at baseline and after dietetic intervention.

pmc-13241134.title: The Effectiveness of Peer Interaction-based Edutainment in Oral Health Promotion among Elementary School Students: A Systematic Review
pmc-13241134.creator: Rara W Gayatri, Taufan Bramantoro, Dini Setyowati, Nor A M Nor, Nurnaningsih H Ulfa, Farah Paramita, Febrita P Heynoek
pmc-13241134.description: Objectives:To systematically review the effectiveness of edutainment with a peer-interaction approach in improving knowledge, attitudes, and oral health behaviors among elementary school students (aged 6–12 years).Methods:A systematic search of PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science was conducted through July 2025 following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines.

pmc-13455829.title: The Natural Product Corramycin Acts as a DNA Gyrase Poison and Overcomes Fluoroquinolone Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
pmc-13455829.creator: Franziska Fries, Jennifer Herrmann, Michael Dal Molin, Yaëlle Wormser, Timo Risch, Yunsheng Gao, Gareth Prosser, Francesca Gubellini, Ariel Mechaly, Joshua B Wallach, Anthony Castro, Arka Banerjee, Sari Rasheed, Alexander Horn, Mathias Müsken, Michael Kurz, Lindsay Sonnenkalb, Viola Dreyer, Stefan N
pmc-13455829.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite significant advancements in drug development and discovery, tuberculosis remains one of the world's deadliest infectious diseases. The rise and global spread of multidrug‐resistant strains underscore a critical need for new antibiotics with distinct mechanisms of action. Screening of a myxobacterial extract library uncovered the previously unrecognized antitubercular activity of corramycin, a natural product with potent bactericidal activity against both drug‐sensitive and ‐resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
